#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Real shell transports against a loopback-only stalled HTTP peer. The pinned
# installed harness is separately qualified by the group B audit receipt.
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)
export ROOT
python3 - <<'PY'
import http.server
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import threading
import time

root=Path(os.environ['ROOT'])
requests=[]
class Peer(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self,*_args):pass
    def do_POST(self):
        self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('content-length','0')))
        requests.append(self.path)
        if self.path.endswith('/body'):
            self.send_response(200);self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json');self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(b'{');self.wfile.flush()
        time.sleep(8)
server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Peer)
threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
url=f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='guard-deadline-') as tmp:
    out=Path(tmp);base=dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin',HOME=tmp,FACTORY_OUT_DIR=tmp,FACTORY_JEV_LIB=str(root/'agent/lib/jev.sh'),FACTORY_JEV_GUARD='shadow')
    event=json.dumps(dict(tool_name='Bash',cwd='/work',tool_input=dict(command='git status')))
    for label, extra in [('proxy',dict(FACTORY_JEV_PROXY_URL=url,FACTORY_JEV_CAPABILITY='fjc_fixture',FACTORY_JEV_PROXY_TIMEOUT_S='25')),('direct-headers',dict(OPENROUTER_API_KEY='loopback-only',FACTORY_JEV_ENDPOINT=url+'/headers',FACTORY_JEV_TIMEOUT_S='20')),('direct-body',dict(OPENROUTER_API_KEY='loopback-only',FACTORY_JEV_ENDPOINT=url+'/body',FACTORY_JEV_TIMEOUT_S='20'))]:
        before=len(requests);started=time.monotonic();r=subprocess.run(['bash',str(root/'agent/hooks/jev-guard.sh')],input=event,text=True,capture_output=True,env=dict(base,**extra),timeout=6);elapsed=time.monotonic()-started
        assert r.returncode==0,(label,r.stderr)
        assert len(requests)==before+1,(label,requests,list(out.iterdir()),r.stderr)
        assert elapsed<4,(label,elapsed)
        assert r.stdout=='',(label,r.stdout)
        print(f'{label}: {elapsed*1000:.1f}ms (<4000 semantic / <6000 hook)')
    lib=out/'stalled-preparation.sh';lib.write_text('factory_jev_available(){ return 0; }\nfactory_jev_decide(){ sleep 8; }\n')
    started=time.monotonic();r=subprocess.run(['bash',str(root/'agent/hooks/jev-guard.sh')],input=event,text=True,capture_output=True,env=dict(base,FACTORY_JEV_LIB=str(lib)),timeout=6);elapsed=time.monotonic()-started
    assert elapsed<4 and r.returncode==0,(elapsed,r.stderr)
    print(f'preparation stall: {elapsed*1000:.1f}ms')
    before=len(requests);started=time.monotonic();r=subprocess.run(['bash',str(root/'agent/hooks/jev-guard.sh')],input=json.dumps(dict(tool_name='Bash',cwd='/work',tool_input=dict(command='rm -rf /etc'))),text=True,capture_output=True,env=dict(base,FACTORY_JEV_GUARD='enforce',FACTORY_JEV_PROXY_URL=url,FACTORY_JEV_CAPABILITY='fjc_fixture'),timeout=1);elapsed=time.monotonic()-started
    assert json.loads(r.stdout)['hookSpecificOutput']['permissionDecision']=='deny',r
    assert len(requests)==before and elapsed<1
    print(f'floor denial: {elapsed*1000:.1f}ms; zero requests')
    # Same additive duration contract also works outside the hook, while the
    # legacy three-argument shape still reaches the configured endpoint once.
    state=out/'state.json';q=out/'q.json';state.write_text('{}');q.write_text('{"q":{"type":"noul","instructions":"fixture"}}')
    for proxy in (False,True):
        extra=dict(FACTORY_JEV_REMAINING_MS='150')
        if proxy:extra.update(FACTORY_JEV_PROXY_URL=url,FACTORY_JEV_CAPABILITY='fjc_fixture')
        else:extra.update(OPENROUTER_API_KEY='loopback-only',FACTORY_JEV_ENDPOINT=url+'/headers')
        started=time.monotonic();r=subprocess.run(['bash','-c','. "$1"; factory_jev_decide legacy-fixture "$2" "$3"','bash',str(root/'agent/lib/jev.sh'),str(state),str(q)],env=dict(base,**extra),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=1);elapsed=time.monotonic()-started
        assert r.returncode==2 and elapsed<1,(proxy,r,elapsed)
        print(f'legacy remaining-duration proxy={proxy}: {elapsed*1000:.1f}ms')
server.shutdown()
print('guard deadline: all checks passed')
